description: This Kotlin source file defines a MicCaptureManager class for managing microphone input and speech recognition for an Android app's voice features. It handles starting/stopping recognition, processing recognition results, managing conversation state, and interacting with a speech gateway.

classes.name: VoiceConversationRole
classes.description: An enum class representing the role in a voice conversation, either User or Assistant.

classes.name: VoiceConversationEntry
classes.description: A data class representing an entry in the voice conversation, including id, role, text, and streaming status.

classes.name: MicCaptureManager
classes.description: A class managing microphone input, speech recognition, and interaction with a speech gateway within the Android app. Handles recognition lifecycle, conversation state, and speech gateway communication.

methods.name: setMicEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables microphone recognition, starting or stopping recognition accordingly.

methods.name: pauseForTts
methods.description: Pauses recognition for Text-to-Speech playback, stopping current recognition session.

methods.name: resumeAfterTts
methods.description: Resumes microphone recognition after TTS playback.

methods.name: onGatewayConnectionChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in connection state with the speech gateway.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming events from the speech gateway, updating conversation state and recognition results.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts speech recognition session if available and permissions are granted.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops speech recognition and releases resources.

methods.name: startListeningSession
methods.description: Configures and initiates the speech recognizer to start listening.

methods.name: scheduleRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of recognition after a delay, used on errors or timeout.

methods.name: queueRecognizedMessage
methods.description: Adds recognized speech text to the conversation and message queue.

methods.name: scheduleTranscriptFlush
methods.description: Schedules flushing partial transcripts after a brief delay.

methods.name: publishQueue
methods.description: Updates the message queue observable.

methods.name: sendQueuedIfIdle
methods.description: Sends the next queued message if not already sending, manages gateway communication.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for awaiting gateway response for the current run.

methods.name: completePendingTurn
methods.description: Marks the current message turn as complete, removing from queue.

methods.name: queuedWaitingStatus
methods.description: Returns status string indicating number of queued messages awaiting gateway.

methods.name: appendConversation
methods.description: Appends a message to the conversation list, returning its id.

methods.name: updateConversationEntry
methods.description: Updates a specific conversation entry by id.

methods.name: upsertPendingAssistant
methods.description: Inserts or updates the assistant's message in the conversation.

methods.name: playAssistantReplyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously speaks the assistant's reply via TTS.

methods.name: disableMic
methods.description: Disables microphone recognition and cleans up resources.

methods.name: hasMicPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has microphone permission.

methods.name: parseAssistantText
methods.description: Parses assistant message content from a JSON payload.
